facts.fact: 章首：他想去 Lyke 但路太差折返——有人来过，一个闯入者
facts.anchor: I tried to walk into Lyke today, but the road was too bad. I had to turn back. Someone has been here. A trespasser.

facts.fact: 他回到家：家，他终于到家了
facts.anchor: Home, he thought. I’m home at last.

facts.fact: 他怀疑路人的故事：那人自称本地人却不认识去 Lyke 的路，举止冰冷近乎阴险
facts.anchor: And was the story he’d heard even true? The walker had claimed local knowledge, but hadn’t known the way to Lyke, and his manner had been strangely cold – almost sinister, even.

facts.fact: 雪人被破坏：网球放在堆起的衣服上，像生日蛋糕上的樱桃
facts.anchor: And a tennis ball, new and garishly luminous, sitting on top of the bundled clothes, like the cherry on a birthday cake.

facts.fact: 他的愤怒里掺着悲伤——仿佛对雪人的攻击是对那个女人本人的攻击
facts.anchor: rage laced with grief, as if the attack on the snowman was somehow an attack on the woman herself.

facts.fact: 他拒绝相信路人的杀妻故事：Arthur 以他自己的方式爱着她
facts.anchor: Arthur loved her, in his way.

facts.fact: 他删掉两条「我知道你做了什么」的短信并报警
facts.anchor: He deleted them both and called the police.

facts.fact: 他对警察说损失「只是雪人」——警察报以嘲笑
电线里传来 Caroline 的声音：Whitby 那天的回忆——四个人建城堡，Bailey 埋了 Greg 的鞋
facts.anchor: Remember that day at Whitby, love? We built a castle, the four of us. Bailey buried Greg’s shoes in the sand.

facts.fact: Caroline 在电线里警告 Lucy 远离河流——Lucy 正是溺死于河边
facts.anchor: Lucy, oh my darling girl, stay away from the river!

facts.fact: 他自语：在所有鬼魂里，我们自己最残忍
facts.anchor: Of all the ghosts we encounter here, the ghosts of ourselves are the cruellest.

facts.fact: 打给前妻的电话录音变成 Arthur 的声音：轻声些，她就在附近。哦，Caroline。我的 Caroline。
facts.anchor: the recorded voice was unclear; no longer a cool, robotic voice, but that of a confused old man: I’m sorry. I’m sorry. Who is this? This number has been disconnected. Tread softly, she is near. Oh, Caroline. My Caroline.

facts.fact: 失真的声音哭喊着：不要走，不要平静地走，Caroline——全书声音恐怖的顶点
facts.anchor: the distorted voice went on sobbing and pleading. Oh, my Caroline. My lovely girl. This number has been disconnected. I’m sorry. Their words had forked no lightning, no. I’m sorry. Do not. Do not go. Do not go gentle. Caroline.

facts.fact: 他怀疑那是 Arthur 意识到自己杀妻的那一刻
facts.anchor: Was that somehow Arthur’s voice, broadcast from the pylon? Was he hearing the moment at which Arthur realised what he had done?
